$ settings delete global settings_enable_monitor_phantom_procs
exit=0 out=[Deleted 0 rows]
$ device_config delete activity_manager max_phantom_processes
exit=0 out=[Successfully deleted max_phantom_processes from activity_manager]
$ settings put global settings_config_disable_monitor_phantom_procs true
exit=0 out=[]
$ settings put global phantom_process_killer_enable false
exit=0 out=[]
